glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 延 + semantic 虫 (“snake, insect”) – "egg", with particular reference to snake eggs. The non-contracted form is 蜑. In the current version, 延 is abbreviated to 疋. This character was coined at a late stage in Chinese, since it is unattested on oracle bones, bronzes, Shuowen Jiezi and Guangyun.
shuowen: This character was coined at a late stage in Chinese, since it is unattested on oracle bones, bronzes, Shuowen Jiezi and Guangyun.
senses: (Southern Min) unlaid egg of a fowl
